records.name: bridge_server_authoritative_uploads_0023_20261106
statements:
-- Server-authoritative multipart manifests and immutable storage provenance.
-- Apply only after staging isolation and RLS policy review. This migration is additive.
begin;

create schema if not exists bridge_private;

alter table public.bridge_assets
  drop constraint if exists bridge_assets_kind_chk;
alter table public.bridge_assets
  add constraint bridge_assets_kind_chk check (kind in ('poster','poster_vertical','poster_horizontal','thumbnail','screener','master','subtitle','technical','censor_certificate'));

alter table public.bridge_assets
  add column if not exists storage_provider text,
  add column if not exists storage_bucket text,
  add column if not exists storage_namespace text,
  add column if not exists storage_region text,
  add column if not exists storage_endpoint text,
  add column if not exists checksum_sha256 text,
  add column if not exists source_object_key text,
  add column if not exists verified_object_key text,
  add column if not exists object_version_id text,
  add column if not exists object_generation text,
  add column if not exists storage_verified_at timestamptz;

update public.bridge_assets
set source_object_key = coalesce(source_object_key, s3_key)
where source_object_key is null;

alter table public.bridge_assets
  add constraint bridge_assets_storage_provider_chk
    check (storage_provider is null or storage_provider in ('oci','aws_s3','cloudflare_r2','supabase_storage')),
  add constraint bridge_assets_checksum_sha256_chk
    check (checksum_sha256 is null or checksum_sha256 ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'),
  add constraint bridge_assets_verified_pointer_chk
    check (
      (verified_object_key is null and storage_verified_at is null)
      or (verified_object_key is not null and storage_verified_at is not null
          and checksum_sha256 is not null and storage_provider is not null
          and storage_bucket is not null)
    );

create index if not exists bridge_assets_verified_title_idx
  on public.bridge_assets (title_id, storage_verified_at desc)
  where verified_object_key is not null;
create index if not exists bridge_assets_checksum_idx
  on public.bridge_assets (checksum_sha256)
  where checksum_sha256 is not null;

create or replace function bridge_private.prevent_verified_asset_pointer_mutation()
returns trigger
language plpgsql
set search_path = pg_catalog
as $bridge_function$
begin
  if old.verified_object_key is not null and (
    new.verified_object_key is distinct from old.verified_object_key
    or new.checksum_sha256 is distinct from old.checksum_sha256
    or new.storage_provider is distinct from old.storage_provider
    or new.storage_bucket is distinct from old.storage_bucket
    or new.storage_namespace is distinct from old.storage_namespace
    or new.storage_region is distinct from old.storage_region
    or new.storage_endpoint is distinct from old.storage_endpoint
    or new.object_version_id is distinct from old.object_version_id
    or new.object_generation is distinct from old.object_generation
    or new.storage_verified_at is distinct from old.storage_verified_at
  ) then
    raise exception 'Verified storage pointer and provenance are immutable';
  end if;
  return new;
end;
$bridge_function$;

drop trigger if exists bridge_assets_verified_pointer_immutable on public.bridge_assets;
create trigger bridge_assets_verified_pointer_immutable
before update on public.bridge_assets
for each row execute function bridge_private.prevent_verified_asset_pointer_mutation();

create table if not exists bridge_private.upload_sessions (
  id text primary key,
  asset_id text not null references public.bridge_assets(id) on delete cascade,
  actor_user_id text not null,
  actor_is_internal boolean not null default false,
  provider text not null check (provider in ('oci','aws_s3','cloudflare_r2')),
  bucket text not null,
  namespace text,
  region text not null,
  endpoint text not null,
  source_object_key text not null,
  provider_upload_id text not null,
  part_base_url text not null,
  expected_size bigint not null check (expected_size > 0),
  part_size integer not null check (part_size between 10485760 and 67108864),
  state text not null default 'initiated'
    check (state in ('initiated','uploading','assembling','verification_pending','verified','failed','aborted','expired')),
  idempotency_key text not null,
  expires_at timestamptz not null,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  unique (asset_id, idempotency_key),
  unique (provider, bucket, provider_upload_id)
);

create index if not exists bridge_upload_sessions_state_expiry_idx
  on bridge_private.upload_sessions (state, expires_at);

create table if not exists bridge_private.upload_parts (
  session_id text not null references bridge_private.upload_sessions(id) on delete cascade,
  part_number integer not null check (part_number > 0),
  byte_start bigint not null check (byte_start >= 0),
  byte_end bigint not null check (byte_end > byte_start),
  byte_length bigint generated always as (byte_end - byte_start) stored,
  etag text not null check (length(etag) between 1 and 512),
  provider_checksum text,
  recorded_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  primary key (session_id, part_number)
);

create table if not exists bridge_private.asset_verification_jobs (
  id bigserial primary key,
  asset_id text not null references public.bridge_assets(id) on delete cascade,
  session_id text not null references bridge_private.upload_sessions(id) on delete cascade,
  status text not null default 'queued' check (status in ('queued','running','succeeded','failed')),
  attempts integer not null default 0 check (attempts >= 0),
  available_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  locked_at timestamptz,
  last_error text,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  unique (session_id)
);

create index if not exists bridge_asset_verification_jobs_claim_idx
  on bridge_private.asset_verification_jobs (available_at, created_at)
  where status in ('queued','failed');

alter table bridge_private.upload_sessions enable row level security;
alter table bridge_private.upload_sessions force row level security;
alter table bridge_private.upload_parts enable row level security;
alter table bridge_private.upload_parts force row level security;
alter table bridge_private.asset_verification_jobs enable row level security;
alter table bridge_private.asset_verification_jobs force row level security;

revoke all on schema bridge_private from public, anon, authenticated;
revoke all on all tables in schema bridge_private from public, anon, authenticated;
revoke all on all sequences in schema bridge_private from public, anon, authenticated;

commit;

records.name: bridge_workspace_verified_identity_guard_20261106
statements:
create or replace function bridge_private.can_manage_title(p_title_id text)
returns boolean language sql stable security definer
set search_path = pg_catalog, public
as $$
  select exists (
    select 1 from public.bridge_titles t
    where t.id = p_title_id and (
      bridge_private.is_admin()
      or exists (
        select 1 from public.bridge_profiles p
        where p.user_id = bridge_private.current_user_id()
          and p.email_verified = true
          and (
            (t.owner_user_id = p.user_id and p.account_type in ('independent_creator','studio'))
            or (
              t.owner_account_type = 'studio'
              and t.owner_organization_id is not null
              and exists (
                select 1 from public.bridge_organization_memberships m
                where m.organization_id = t.owner_organization_id
                  and m.user_id = p.user_id
                  and m.status = 'active'
              )
            )
          )
      )
    )
  );
$$;

statements:
-- Revenue & Distribution Intelligence
-- Additive, read-model foundation for Studio and Creator revenue visibility.
-- No existing title, upload, payment, or service ledger rows are modified.

create table if not exists public.bridge_channel_statement_lines (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  title_id text not null references public.bridge_titles(id) on delete restrict,
  channel_code text not null check (channel_code ~ '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]{1,63}$'),
  channel_name text not null,
  period_start date not null,
  period_end date not null,
  currency text not null default 'INR' check (currency ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$'),
  estimate_amount_minor bigint check (estimate_amount_minor is null or estimate_amount_minor >= 0),
  reported_gross_minor bigint check (reported_gross_minor is null or reported_gross_minor >= 0),
  adjustments_minor bigint not null default 0,
  net_amount_minor bigint check (net_amount_minor is null or net_amount_minor >= 0),
  statement_status text not null default 'ESTIMATED'
    check (statement_status in ('ESTIMATED','REPORTED','RECONCILED','DISPUTED')),
  statement_reference text,
  source_hash text unique,
  received_at timestamptz,
  reconciled_at timestamptz,
  created_by text,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  constraint bridge_channel_statement_period_chk check (period_end >= period_start),
  constraint bridge_channel_statement_amounts_chk check (
    net_amount_minor is null
    or reported_gross_minor is null
    or net_amount_minor = greatest(0, reported_gross_minor + adjustments_minor)
  )
);

create index if not exists bridge_channel_statement_title_period_idx
  on public.bridge_channel_statement_lines(title_id, period_end desc);
create index if not exists bridge_channel_statement_channel_period_idx
  on public.bridge_channel_statement_lines(channel_code, period_end desc);
create index if not exists bridge_channel_statement_status_idx
  on public.bridge_channel_statement_lines(statement_status, period_end desc);

create table if not exists public.bridge_channel_payment_schedule (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  statement_line_id uuid not null unique
    references public.bridge_channel_statement_lines(id) on delete restrict,
  estimate_available_at date,
  payment_due_at date,
  payment_posted_at timestamptz,
  paid_amount_minor bigint check (paid_amount_minor is null or paid_amount_minor >= 0),
  payment_reference text,
  payment_status text not null default 'SCHEDULED'
    check (payment_status in ('SCHEDULED','PAYMENT_PENDING','PAID','OVERDUE','DISPUTED')),
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  constraint bridge_channel_payment_dates_chk check (
    payment_due_at is null or estimate_available_at is null or payment_due_at >= estimate_available_at
  )
);

create index if not exists bridge_channel_payment_due_idx
  on public.bridge_channel_payment_schedule(payment_status, payment_due_at);

alter table public.bridge_channel_statement_lines enable row level security;
alter table public.bridge_channel_payment_schedule enable row level security;

-- Access is through verified, server-side Bridge functions only. Do not expose
-- these financial records through the Supabase Data API.
revoke all on public.bridge_channel_statement_lines from public, anon, authenticated;
revoke all on public.bridge_channel_payment_schedule from public, anon, authenticated;

comment on table public.bridge_channel_statement_lines is
  'Channel-reported title-level estimates and statement amounts. Estimates are not payments.';
comment on table public.bridge_channel_payment_schedule is
  'Expected and confirmed channel payment dates linked to a statement line.';

records.name: 20261106_story_concept_buyer_mandates
statements:
-- Authorized target: Crayons Projects - Testing DB only. Never apply to Production.
-- Additive Story Concept Buyer / Investor mandate grants.
-- Existing Testing schema uses UUID concept IDs and UUID organization IDs.
alter table public.bridge_profiles
  drop constraint if exists bridge_profiles_account_type_chk;
alter table public.bridge_profiles
  add constraint bridge_profiles_account_type_chk
  check (account_type in ('independent_creator', 'studio', 'buyer', 'investor'));

-- Private OCI object keys are server-only references.
alter table public.bridge_story_concept_submissions
  add column if not exists treatment_object_key text,
  add column if not exists screenplay_object_key text,
  add column if not exists treatment_pending_object_key text,
  add column if not exists screenplay_pending_object_key text,
  add column if not exists reviewed_by text,
  add column if not exists reviewed_at timestamptz,
  add column if not exists fee_certified_at timestamptz;

-- Preserve legacy curation states while enabling the Story Concept workflow.
alter table public.bridge_story_concept_submissions
  drop constraint if exists bridge_story_concept_submissions_curation_status_check;
alter table public.bridge_story_concept_submissions
  add constraint bridge_story_concept_submissions_curation_status_check
  check (curation_status in (
    'PENDING', 'UNDER_REVIEW', 'APPROVED', 'REJECTED', 'INTRODUCED_TO_BUYERS',
    'PENDING_REVIEW', 'CHANGES_REQUESTED', 'BUYER_EVALUATION_APPROVED'
  ));

create table if not exists public.bridge_story_concept_mandates (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  concept_submission_id uuid not null
    references public.bridge_story_concept_submissions(id) on delete cascade,
  grantee_organization_id uuid not null
    references public.bridge_organizations(id),
  grantee_account_type text not null
    check (grantee_account_type in ('buyer', 'investor')),
  grant_status text not null default 'PENDING'
    check (grant_status in ('PENDING', 'ACTIVE', 'REVOKED', 'EXPIRED')),
  curation_status text not null default 'PENDING'
    check (curation_status in ('PENDING', 'BUYER_EVALUATION_APPROVED', 'REJECTED')),
  fee_certified_at timestamptz,
  expires_at timestamptz,
  revoked_at timestamptz,
  created_by text not null,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  constraint bridge_story_concept_mandates_expiry_after_creation
    check (expires_at is null or expires_at > created_at)
);

create unique index if not exists bridge_story_concept_mandates_grantee_unique_idx
  on public.bridge_story_concept_mandates
    (concept_submission_id, grantee_organization_id, grantee_account_type);
create index if not exists bridge_story_concept_mandates_org_active_idx
  on public.bridge_story_concept_mandates
    (grantee_organization_id, grantee_account_type, concept_submission_id, expires_at)
  where grant_status = 'ACTIVE' and revoked_at is null;
create index if not exists bridge_story_concept_mandates_concept_idx
  on public.bridge_story_concept_mandates (concept_submission_id);

alter table public.bridge_story_concept_mandates enable row level security;
revoke all on public.bridge_story_concept_mandates from anon, authenticated;

statements:
create table if not exists bridge_private.buyer_accounts (

  buyer_name text,
  primary_contact_name text,
  primary_contact_email text,
  normalized_contact_email text,

    check (account_status in ('active','paused','restricted','closed')),
  source_mailbox text not null default 'hostinger',
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  unique (normalized_contact_email)
);

create table if not exists bridge_private.buyer_requirements (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  buyer_account_id uuid not null references bridge_private.buyer_accounts(id) on delete cascade,
  requirement_key text not null unique,
  requirement_status text not null default 'new'
    check (requirement_status in ('new','active','paused','closed','needs_review')),
  content_types text[] not null default '{}',
  languages text[] not null default '{}',
  genres text[] not null default '{}',
  territories text[] not null default '{}',
  rights_types text[] not null default '{}',
  platforms text[] not null default '{}',
  commercial_models text[] not null default '{}',
  technical_specs jsonb not null default '{}'::jsonb,
  exclusions text[] not null default '{}',
  min_runtime_minutes integer,
  max_runtime_minutes integer,
  release_window text,
  requirement_summary text not null,
  confidence numeric(5,2) not null default 0 check (confidence between 0 and 100),
  last_mail_at timestamptz,
  last_reviewed_at timestamptz,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  check (min_runtime_minutes is null or min_runtime_minutes >= 0),
  check (max_runtime_minutes is null or max_runtime_minutes >= 0),
  check (min_runtime_minutes is null or max_runtime_minutes is null or min_runtime_minutes <= max_runtime_minutes)
);

create table if not exists bridge_private.buyer_requirement_evidence (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  buyer_requirement_id uuid not null references bridge_private.buyer_requirements(id) on delete cascade,

  received_at timestamptz,

  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),

    check (match_status in ('potential','partial','no_match','rights_blocked','technical_blocked','commercial_mismatch','needs_review')),
  fit_score numeric(5,2) not null default 0 check (fit_score between 0 and 100),
  matched_dimensions jsonb not null default '{}'::jsonb,
  reasons jsonb not null default '[]'::jsonb,
  blockers jsonb not null default '[]'::jsonb,
  computed_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  reviewed_by text,
  reviewed_at timestamptz,
  unique (buyer_requirement_id, title_id)
);

create index if not exists buyer_requirements_status_idx

create index if not exists buyer_evidence_requirement_idx

grant select, insert, update, delete on bridge_private.buyer_requirements to service_role;
grant select, insert, update, delete on bridge_private.buyer_requirement_evidence to service_role;
